body: Commits 1b16252/389a396 on main. Split out from the old bundled S170-69 northstar item -- draft used to auto-pick instantly with no UI (S170-66/68). Now a real 26-hero clickable grid screen replaces the normal match view during ARENA_PHASE_DRAFT until the player picks. Replaced the old auto-pick's net_draft_offset formula with net_picked_hero_id so the resend safety net resends the real click. No auto-fallback on AFK, deliberate scope decision. Build clean, full suite green; server-side draft flow (untouched) verified via isolated bot-vs-bot match on a fresh port -- the human click UI itself isn't automatable in this sandbox (no xdotool), flagged not faked.
title: Real draft pick-a-hero UI, replacing auto-draft (S170-182)
